quote: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: A rate of speed greater than is reasonable or proper, having due regard for the traffic, surface and width of the highway, the weather and other highway conditions.

activation.condition: the subject drives or operates a vehicle of any kind

obligation.description: Do not drive faster than is reasonable or proper for traffic, road, weather, and other conditions.

timing.description: the basic speed rule binds at every instant; the conditions it is judged against change frame by frame

judgment_calls_needed.note: tier S: 'reasonable or proper' is the whole obligation. Any rule is a surrogate whose bounds come from a stopping- or sight-distance model, declared as an operationalization claim
Reasonable speed has no statutory numeric bound here.
